title: Semi-dynamic leach testing of densified silicon-based iodine waste forms
content:

Amanda R. Lawter, Gemma G. Clark, Nancy Escobedo, Jeff Bonnett, Nathan Canfield, Seungrag Choi, Mark E. Bowden, Josef Matyas, R. Matthew Asmussen
Iodine is a radionuclide of concern in nuclear waste repositories. Prior to disposal, iodine must be immobilized in an iodine waste form, the performance of which can be represented in a conceptual corrosion release model.
